summary: Implemented Node.js service for PostgreSQL to MongoDB migration supporting dual-write, CDC synchronization, validation parity checks, and rollback control using feature flags. It ensures zero downtime, data integrity, and backward-compatible API endpoints.

code_files.description: Controller handling customer profile CRUD and feature-flagged dual-write operations between PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
Controller handling migration validation and rollback endpoints.
Service implementing dual-write logic to both PostgreSQL and MongoDB during transitional phase.
Service performing Parity Validation between PostgreSQL and MongoDB datasets.
Service handling rollback to PostgreSQL using feature flag toggling.
Utility wrapper for LaunchDarkly feature flag controls.
Service providing PostgreSQL customer operations using pg library.
Centralized logger utility for consistent audit trail and error handling.
Utility for validating incoming customer data against JSON schema before writing.
